definitions.explanation: A book used alongside the main textbook in school education to provide additional material or different perspectives on a subject. Often produced by local governments or educational boards.

examples.japanese: {副読本|ふくどくほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{道徳|どうとく}→道徳：03478_doutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{副読本|ふくどくほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: We used a supplementary reader in the moral education class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}した→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副読本|ふくどくほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全校|ぜんこう}→全校：28166_zenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配|くば}られた→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。

notes:
{副読本|ふくどくほん} is a supplementary textbook used alongside the main textbook (⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧) in Japanese schools, primarily at the elementary and junior high school level.

KEY DIFFERENCE FROM {教科書|きょうかしょ}:
- ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧ requires {文部科学省|もんぶかがくしょう} (Ministry of Education) approval
- {副読本|ふくどくほん} does not require ministry approval and is often created by local municipalities or educational boards

COMMON SUBJECTS:
- ⟦{道徳|どうとく}→道徳：03478_doutoku⟧ (moral education)
- ⟦{郷土|きょうど}→郷土：14407_kyoudo⟧⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧ (local studies)
- ⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧ (disaster preparedness)
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (environmental education)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副読本|ふくどくほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (distribute supplementary readers)
- {副読本|ふくどくほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (use a supplementary reader)
